title: PAFT: A Parallel Training Paradigm for Effective LLM Fine-Tuning

contributions.purpose: 缓解顺序式 SFT→偏好对齐流水线导致的 alignment tax(灾难性遗忘)
contributions.mechanism: PAFT 并行训练范式:用同一预训练模型在各自数据集上独立做 SFT 与偏好对齐(DPO/ORPO),再通过参数融合(LoRA adapter 合并)得到最终模型
contributions.evaluation: 在 Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B 上于六项 benchmark 对比并行/顺序/单独训练,并行训练在减少 alignment tax 上更优;结论在 ORPO 上复现,证明可泛化
contributions.domain: 大语言模型微调 / 偏好对齐
contributions.source_quote: Evidence is presented that parallel training of SFT and preference alignment outperforms sequential training, effectively reducing the alignment tax.

contributions.purpose: 解决模型合并时的参数干扰,防止合并冲突同时保留各模型能力
contributions.mechanism: 发现 DPO 天然稀疏、SFT 天然稠密;对 SFT 损失加 L1-norm 惩罚以隐式诱导 delta 参数稀疏化(interference resolution)
contributions.evaluation: TIES 合并下 PAFT(SFTsparse+DPO)得 0.6524 对比无稀疏化 Parallel SFT+DPO 的 0.5893;DARE TIES 下 0.6479 vs 0.5726;显式稀疏方法 DARE 被证不如 L1
contributions.domain: 大语言模型微调 / 模型合并
contributions.source_quote: The significance of sparse model integration is highlighted as a mean to prevent model conflict while preserving the full capability of each model. We demonstrate the superiority of the L1-norm over DARE as a more effective and higher-quality method for promoting sparsity in model training across various model merging techniques.

contributions.purpose: 在公开基准上全面验证 PAFT 有效性
contributions.mechanism: 在 Open LLM Leaderboard 与 AlpacaEval 上综合评测,含不同 base 模型与合并方法
contributions.evaluation: PAFT-ed 7B 模型在 Open LLM Leaderboard 7B/8B 类别 Rank #1,70B 模型全球登顶;AlpacaEval 上 70B 优于多数 SOTA(除 GPT-4 Preview/Claude 3 Opus 的 LC Win-Rate)
contributions.domain: 大语言模型微调 / 评测
contributions.source_quote: We conduct comprehensive evaluation of PAFT on well-known public benchmarks including Open LLM Leaderboard and AlpacaEval. The PAFT-ed 7B model achieved Rank #1 in the 7B/8B model category on the Open LLM Leaderboard, and the PAFT-ed 70B model topped the Leaderboard globally.

self_declared_provenance.quote: As discovered by prior work Yadav et al. (2023); Yu et al. (2023), direct model merging causes the parameter values to interfere across models, thereby harming the performance of the final model.

This method of implicitly inducing sparsity has been evaluated against a technique that introduces sparsity explicitly, i.e., DARE Yu et al. (2023), demonstrating the advantages of employing the L1-norm
we explore a variety of merging methods proposed in the literature, including SLERP, Task Arithmetic, TIES, DARE TIES, and Linear.

notes: 报告了一个内部负/对比结果:单独 SFT 在 Mistral-7B 上不提升甚至损害平均分(SFT 缺人类偏好对齐),而单独 DPO 提升——支撑其并行融合动机。AlpacaEval 上 70B 未能全面超越 GPT-4 Preview/Claude 3 Opus(LC Win-Rate),属 comparable/落后信号。整体基调为全面正结果 + Rank #1 主张。
